name: informer-mcp
description: Read and write Informer bookkeeping data: relations, invoices, quotations, orders, receipts and reports.
long_description:
Connects Claude to the Informer (informer.nl) bookkeeping API. Covers relations, sales and purchase invoices, recurring invoices, quotations, sales orders, receipts, products and financial reports.

A bookkeeper can configure several client administrations at once, each with its own credentials and its own read-only or read-write setting; every tool then requires you to say which client it applies to.

Credentials are entered in a local browser page, never in a conversation. Leave the fields below empty and the page opens by itself the first time the server starts.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: For a single administration, from app.informer.eu/settings/api. Leave empty to fill it in later on the setup page, which is also how you add more than one administration.

security_code.title: Security code
security_code.description: The security code of the same administration, from app.informer.eu/settings/account.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that creates, changes or deletes anything. Leave off to allow writing.
